map.输入体积流量 Q 与过流断面面积 A，按 v = Q/A 计算平均流速，适用于管: Enter volumetric flow Q and cross-sectional area A to compute average velocity as v = Q/A, suited to back-calculating velocity at any section of a pipe or open channel and checking it against code limits.
map.已知流量与断面反推流速。: Back out velocity from known flow and section.
map.变断面处流速变化分析。: Analyze velocity change at varying sections.
map.：Q=0.1 m³/s、A=π×0.05²≈0.00785 ㎡ → v=0.1/: : Q=0.1 m³/s, A=π×0.05²≈0.00785 m² → v=0.1/0.00785≈12.7 m/s, which is high and needs a larger diameter.
map.：D 0.1→0.15，A 增 2.25 倍，同流量 v 降到约 5.7 m/s: : D 0.1→0.15 raises A by 2.25×, and at the same flow v drops to about 5.7 m/s.
map.公式为断面平均流速，实际分布不均，设计用平均值校核。: The formula gives section-average velocity; the actual profile is uneven, so design checks use the average.
map.v=Q/A 即连续性在不可压流的直接表达，变径必变 v。: v=Q/A is the direct expression of continuity for incompressible flow, so a change of diameter must change v.
